correctness.rationale: Poisson superposition gives N(t)~Poisson((2λ+μ)t) independent of marked jump chain. With equal starting weights w, after n rings D=C1−C2 has conditional mean increment mα(d,n)=c*tanh(α*arctanh(d/(2w+n))), c=μ/(2λ+μ). The absolute chain K=|D| moves one step outward/inward, outward probability increasing in α; using common uniforms and same parity of both chains makes the integer order pathwise monotone. A strictly positive outward-event difference at n2 gives strictly increasing second moments for n≥2. Reflection symmetry E D_n=0 and Cov(N,D_N)=0 yield exact Cov(C1,C2)=(Λt−E D_N²)/4 and corr=(Λt−E D_N²)/(Λt+E D_N²), hence strictly decreasing covariance and negative for α>0. Concavity tanh(αu)≥α tanh(u) implies v_{n+1}≥(1+2cα/(2w+n))v_n+1, giving v_n/n→∞ at cα≥1/2 (nlogn at equality, n^{2cα} above). Poisson concentration yields Corr→−1; this region exists for α<1 iff μ>2λ. Independently reconstructed finite-state distributions at n=2,6,20,60 for α=0,.3,.6,.85,.95; variance increases throughout. The asymptotic follows analytically, not from these tests.
